_comment: ACE-Step section-repaint API workflow: regenerate seconds [repaint_start, repaint_end] of an EXISTING take and keep the rest. Verified against the installed ComfyUI_ACE-Step (MW) pack on 2026-08-15 by reading ace_step_nodes.py + pipeline_ace_step.py and the pack's own ACE-rapainting.json example. THE MODEL IS NOT THE ONE COMPOSE USES, and that is the single most important fact about this file: acestep15_audio.json runs ACE-Step *1.5 turbo* through core ComfyUI (UNETLoader + TextEncodeAceStepAudio1.5 + KSampler), while every studio verb (ACEStepEdit/Extend/Repainting) belongs to the MW custom-node pack, which loads ACE-Step *1.0* 3.5B from models/TTS/ACE-Step-v1-3.5B as an ACE_MODELS bundle. There is no 1.5 repaint node on this install. So the repainted window is voiced by a different model than the surrounding track, and matching the seam is a listening judgement, not a parameter. WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT TEMPLATED: (1) node 5 audio_duration is INERT - ACEStepRepainting overwrites parameters['audio_duration'] with librosa.get_duration(src_audio) before calling the pipeline, so the value here can never take effect; it is left at the pack's own default rather than templated, so nobody tunes a dead knob. (2) node 5 seed must stay NONZERO. GenerationParameters only pops 'seed' into 'manual_seeds' when seed != 0; at zero it leaves a literal seed= in the kwargs that reach pipeline.__call__, which has no seed parameter, and the run dies with a TypeError after the models are already loaded. The plugin enforces this rather than trusting the template. (3) node 6 overlapped_decode stays false - it is a decode-memory tradeoff, not a quality control. (4) repaint_start/repaint_end are SECONDS (ints): the pipeline converts them at 44100/512/8 = 10.766 latent frames per second, and clamps repaint_end to the source duration. (5) repaint_variance is the one knob that decides whether this does anything at all: the pipeline sets n_min = int(infer_step * (1 - retake_variance)) and skips every step before n_min, so the pack's own default of 0.01 denoises the last 1% of steps and returns a near-copy. The pack's shipped example uses 0.49. A repaint that changes nothing and a repaint that changes everything are the two failure modes, and this is the dial between them.
